page: Microsoft Azure F4amds_v7 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the Famdsv7 server family. Powered by an x86_64 AMD processor, this instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs and is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage needs, the F4amds_v7 includes a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD. The instance is also premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. It does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the F4amds_v7 offers a balanced profile for memory-heavy workloads that do not require massive compute scaling. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and fast local NVMe storage make this server type suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, medium-scale data processing, and enterprise applications requiring a larger memory footprint relative to processing cores.
